tools.name: GetEmail

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: The Resend-assigned identifier of the email to retrieve.

tools.name: SendEmail
tools.description:
Send a transactional email through Resend.

Returns the Resend-assigned email_id. When scheduled_at is provided, the email is
queued for later delivery instead of sent immediately.

parameters.name: from_address
parameters.description: Sender address as a bare email or formatted display name plus email, e.g. 'Acme <user@example.com>'. The sender domain must be verified in Resend.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Recipient email addresses. At least 1 and at most 50 entries.

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: HTML body of the email. Provide at least one of 'html' or 'text'. Defaults to an empty string, which sends no HTML body.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Plain-text body of the email. Provide at least one of 'html' or 'text'. Defaults to an empty string, which sends no plain-text body.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: CC recipients. Defaults to no CC recipients.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: BCC recipients. Defaults to no BCC recipients.

parameters.name: reply_to
parameters.description: Reply-To addresses. Replies from recipients are directed here instead of the sender. Defaults to the sender.

parameters.name: scheduled_at
parameters.description: When to deliver the message, as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) or natural language understood by Resend ('in 1 hour'). Defaults to an empty string, which sends immediately.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: Files to attach, each fetched by Resend from a remote URL. Every attachment needs a 'filename' and a 'url' pointing to a publicly accessible file (not a local path). Optional 'content_type' overrides MIME detection. Defaults to no attachments.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Custom tags for analytics or filtering. Each entry has a 'name' and a 'value'. Defaults to no tags.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Additional RFC 822 headers as a flat key/value mapping (e.g. {'X-Entity-Ref-ID': '...'}). Defaults to no extra headers.

output.description: Identifier of the newly queued or sent email.

tools.name: UpdateEmail
tools.description: Reschedule a not-yet-sent email by updating its scheduled_at timestamp.

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the scheduled email to reschedule.

parameters.name: scheduled_at
parameters.description: New send time as ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) or natural language ('in 1 hour'). Only emails that have not yet been sent can be rescheduled.

summary:
The Resend toolkit integrates Arcade with [Resend](https://resend.com) to send and manage transactional email via LLM-callable tools.

## Capabilities

- **Send & schedule email**: Send transactional email immediately or queue it for future delivery using a `scheduled_at` timestamp; returns the Resend-assigned `email_id`.
- **Manage scheduled email**: Reschedule or cancel queued (not-yet-sent) emails by their ID.
- **Email status inspection**: Retrieve a single email record by ID, including its current delivery status.

## Secrets

`RESEND_API_KEY` — A Resend API key used to authenticate all requests. Generate one in the [Resend dashboard under API Keys](https://resend.com/api-keys). Create a key with **Full access** (or at minimum **Sending access**) for the domains you intend to use; note that cancellation and rescheduling require the key to have permission to manage emails. Free-tier Resend accounts can generate API keys but are limited to sending from `onboarding@resend.dev` until a custom domain is verified.

Store this secret in Arcade and reference it in your tool configuration. See the [Arcade secrets guide](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) for setup instructions, or manage secrets directly at https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets.
